sign: Bottom of the rope. Welcome to Quivermoor. The ground is breathing. Do not hold your breath with it.
North: the Breathing Bog to Tallowmere. South: the Wandering Wood to Rootchapel.

lines: Moss Nurse Hedda: Lie down. The moss is soft and warm. That is how it gets you, but not tonight.
Peddler Osric Fane: Tonics, rope, candles. The candles are cheap. Having one lit for you costs more.
trader.action: shop strong_tonic max_tonic remedy cooling_gel wake_bell revival_leaf dash_brew guard_brew focus_brew

lines: Bog Cutter Wilmot: I cut peat for the fires. Last week the peat had a ring in it. Still on the finger.
Moss Girl Prue: The gate has no wall because the moss ate it. It's still hungry. I feed it gossip.
Old Cobb: I came down that rope forty years ago. I'm still waiting for my change.
Reeve Bram Ashby of Mossgate hires you to quiet the four Rifts that make the moor breathe. He pays in candles. Everyone here does.
Reeve Ashby: Four Rifts, four Wardens, one candle a day as wages. Sign the book. Everyone who comes down the rope signs the book.
Reeve Ashby: Tallowmere first, up through the bog. The Wick Rift is behind the Choir. Mind the candles, one of them is yours.
The winch man cut the rope ten metres short to save the haul back up. He billed Halcyra for a Wayfarer lost to the bog. The bog was soft. His invoice was not.
A candle with your name was lit the day you arrived. Maudrey sold its burn time to Reeve Ashby, who opened a book on how long you would last.
Reeve Ashby: A book on how long you would last? Business. You're doing well in it. Rootchapel next, Nell will pole you there.
Nell, your raft pilot and only friend on the moor, steered you to the chapel on Ossian's orders. The roots are fed on a schedule. You were the schedule.
Reeve Ashby: Nell? Shocking. Driftwick next. I'll come along. I have money riding on the trip.
Ashby cut Driftwick's anchor lines with you aboard. Your candle was still burning and he had bet against it. He hates losing money more than he hates you.
Reeve Ashby: You're still alive. That cost me a fortune. Go to Lastbloom and lose there, I'm owed.
Winch Hand Gorm: The rope goes up to Whitecairn. Up costs double. Gravity is on my side going down, not going up.

rope_sign: Baskets to Whitecairn. Mended weekly. Paid for occasionally.
